==About Voicelines==
{{VO
|character                   = Baizhi
|language                    = en

<!-- Thoughts -->
|vo_01_01_title              = Thoughts: I
|vo_01_01_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts I.ogg
|vo_01_01_tx                 = You possess special powers related to sound. By observing you... I may be able to find a breakthrough in Ecoacoustics studies. If this ever makes you uncomfortable, please do let me know. Maintaining interpersonal relationships is not my strong suit, but I want to keep a balance between satiating my desire for knowledge and respecting your boundaries.

|vo_01_02_title              = Thoughts: II
|vo_01_02_intimacy           = 1
|vo_01_02_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts II.ogg
|vo_01_02_tx                 = Some believe {{Extra Effect|Remnant|Remnant Energy|A form of pure energy with complete frequencies. The information it carries transcends time and space, enduring in a stable, unchanging state.}} Creatures are embodiments of souls. Indeed, their frequencies are pure and clear—qualities commonly associated with the idea of a "soul". That said, I have a question... {{Extra Effect|You'tan|You'tan|A Remnant Creature reminiscent of a white udumbara. It can communicate with Baizhi through telepathy.}} stays with me because it embodies my ideals. Then, all those Mutterflies that are attracted to you... What do they represent that is yours? Perhaps... the answer lies within your lost memories.

|vo_01_03_title              = Thoughts: III
|vo_01_03_intimacy           = 2
|vo_01_03_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts III.ogg
|vo_01_03_tx                 = My doubt about the then universally accepted Ecoacoustic theories provoked me to direct my research accordingly. I questioned the long-held notion that {{Extra Effect|Remnant}} Creatures are intangible, and I continued to explore the possibilities, chasing every clue I could find. Eventually, I received a response from {{Extra Effect|You'tan}} in one of the ruins, disproving that theory. Now, I am posed with a variety of other questions that I'm attempting to answer. I believe a claim is always verifiable before it is discredited entirely, and I will keep striving to uncover the truth.

|vo_01_04_title              = Thoughts: IV
|vo_01_04_intimacy           = 3
|vo_01_04_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts IV.ogg
|vo_01_04_tx                 = The world is constantly changing, but every action has its consequences. Like a Goldberg machine, it may seem unpredictable, but if you trace the steps carefully, you can find a rational outcome. Therefore, we should exercise caution in our decisions to avoid any unwanted outcomes. Even if it means sacrificing comfort, I'm willing to go through complex procedures for accuracy. Rover, between facts and feelings, which holds more weight for you?

|vo_01_05_title              = Thoughts: V
|vo_01_05_intimacy           = 4
|vo_01_05_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts V.ogg
|vo_01_05_tx                 = Strange. I was planning to study you as an observer, but now... I am the one opening up to you, telling you things I never thought I would. It feels almost as if... I want you to learn more about me, too. This isn't the plan I had, but somehow, I don't really mind. Perhaps... with more time together, I will deviate further from my usual self, and discover other unexpected feelings.


<!-- Miscellaneous -->
|vo_02_01_title              = Baizhi's Hobby
|vo_02_01_file               = {character}{language} Hobby.ogg
|vo_02_01_tx                 = When I have the time, I travel around {{Extra Effect|Huanglong|Huanglong|Located at the edge of the continent, this country borders the sea to the east. It boasts a vast territory with one capital and six major cities.}} to explore. I sample local delicacies, talk to people, and observe their daily lives. Theory alone cannot convey the full truth; to reach an accurate conclusion, I must experience it firsthand.

|vo_02_02_title              = Baizhi's Trouble
|vo_02_02_file               = {character}{language} Trouble.ogg
|vo_02_02_tx                 = Two words with the same pronunciation do not make people laugh, but when used in certain contexts, people seem to automatically associate them with various meanings and burst into laughter... Puns and memes lack a clear definition. I find them difficult to understand.

|vo_02_03_title              = Favorite Food
|vo_02_03_file               = {character}{language} Favorite Food.ogg
|vo_02_03_tx                 = Vegetables served cold are less prone to moisture loss, and they have a sweeter taste. I recommend iced Perilla salad if you enjoy vegetables, too.

|vo_02_04_title              = Disliked Food
|vo_02_04_file               = {character}{language} Disliked Food.ogg
|vo_02_04_tx                 = Though fried foods can be delicious, it's best to enjoy them in moderation, due to their potential health risks.

|vo_02_05_title              = Ideals
|vo_02_05_file               = {character}{language} Ideals.ogg
|vo_02_05_tx                 = I wouldn't call the emergence of {{Extra Effect|Waveworn Phenomena|Waveworn Phenomena|The Lament's power causes destructive waves across the land of Solaris. Manifestations like the "Tacet Fields," "Tacet Discord Outbreaks," and the enigmatic "Tacetite" are part of what is collectively known as the "Waveworn Phenomena."}} a "disaster" that overturned mankind's established knowledge of the world. I believe it has broadened our horizons, prompting us to rethink and reconstruct our system of knowledge. Though we haven't made much progress yet, our continued effort will bring us closer to understanding.


<!-- Chat -->
|vo_03_01_title              = Chat: I
|vo_03_01_file               = {character}{language} Chat I.ogg
|vo_03_01_tx                 = I wear two rings on my hands. One of them is a reminder of what I should never forget, and the other is a symbol of what I should strive to achieve. My life is too short for trivial matters; I must carry on my pursuit in honor of our pioneers.

|vo_03_02_title              = Chat: II
|vo_03_02_file               = {character}{language} Chat II.ogg
|vo_03_02_tx                 = Withdraw a portion of one's ego, then attach it to the existence of another being in the form of vibrating energy... sounds incredible, doesn't it? It was in this manner that {{Extra Effect|You'tan}} came into existence. I am yet to uncover all the secrets of the {{Extra Effect|Remnant}} Creatures, but perhaps that's why You'tan responded to my call—so I may devote my life in search of the answer.


<!-- About Others -->
|vo_04_01_title              = About [[Yangyang]]
|vo_04_01_intimacy           = 1
|vo_04_01_file               = {character}{language} About Yangyang.ogg
|vo_04_01_tx                 = Some people are good at listening, while some are good at counseling others. Yangyang is good at both. With her, you can just be yourself.
|vo_04_01_mention            = Yangyang

|vo_04_02_title              = About [[Chixia]]
|vo_04_02_intimacy           = 2
|vo_04_02_file               = {character}{language} About Chixia.ogg
|vo_04_02_tx                 = When I first met Chixia, I was indeed a bit overwhelmed... She was always vibrant and lively, and her way of thinking was very different from mine. As our understanding of each other grew, we created a unique synergy. Our differences complemented each other perfectly.
|vo_04_02_mention            = Chixia

|vo_04_03_title              = About [[Mortefi]]
|vo_04_03_intimacy           = 3
|vo_04_03_file               = {character}{language} About Mortefi.ogg
|vo_04_03_tx                 = We didn't converse frequently, but our cooperation was always seamless. He may experience minor inflammation-related health issues because of his Resonance Ability, so I suggest bringing him Bittberry tea next time. A single cup can relieve his symptoms for a whole day.
|vo_04_03_mention            = Mortefi

|vo_04_04_title              = About [[Xiangli Yao]]
|vo_04_04_intimacy           = 4
|vo_04_04_file               = {character}{language} About Xiangli Yao.ogg
|vo_04_04_tx                 = His good temper is almost as impressive as the exceptional talent he has. I've never seen him raise his voice in anger at anyone. No matter how impossible the task sounds, he always delivers.
|vo_04_04_mention            = Xiangli Yao

|vo_04_05_title              = About [[Yuanwu]]
|vo_04_05_intimacy           = 5
|vo_04_05_file               = {character}{language} About Yuanwu.ogg
|vo_04_05_tx                 = The tea Mr. Yuanwu brews always tastes sweeter than those served in teahouses, even if the same recipe and ingredients were used. He told me it was only because he put his sincerity into it. Sincerity... How does it affect the flavor of tea?
|vo_04_05_mention            = Yuanwu


<!-- Birthday -->
|vo_05_01_title              = Birthday Wishes
|vo_05_01_file               = {character}{language} Birthday Wishes.ogg
|vo_05_01_tx                 = You deserve preferential treatment on the day of your birth... Yes, please lean in closer, just like that... {{Extra Effect|You'tan}}'s embrace soothes the body. It has never embraced anyone other than me before today. Happy birthday, Rover. You'tan and I wanted to do something for you. We hope you like it.


<!-- Idles -->
|vo_06_01_title              = Idle: I
|vo_06_01_file               = {character}{language} Idle I.ogg
|vo_06_01_tx                 = Why hesitate, if you know what you want?

|vo_06_02_title              = Idle: II
|vo_06_02_file               = {character}{language} Idle II.ogg
|vo_06_02_tx                 = An unwavering faith will resonate with like-minded souls.

|vo_06_03_title              = Idle: III
|vo_06_03_file               = {character}{language} Idle III.ogg
|vo_06_03_tx                 = I have the key to solving this question.


<!-- Greetings -->
|vo_07_01_title              = Self-Introduction
|vo_07_01_file               = {character}{language} Self-Introduction.ogg
|vo_07_01_tx                 = I am Baizhi, a researcher at the {{Extra Effect|Huaxu Academy|Huaxu Academy|The state-run research institute of Huanglong, with branch organizations established in each city.}}. I specialize in Ecoacoustic studies, and I'm always open to answering questions related to my field. Hmm... I don't mind other types of questions, but please note that I may not be able to answer all of them. It would be best to let me know what you are going to ask in advance, so I can prepare accordingly.

|vo_07_02_title              = Greeting
|vo_07_02_file               = {character}{language} Greeting.ogg
|vo_07_02_tx                 = I am Baizhi, a researcher at the Huaxu Academy. Let me witness where this encounter will take us.


<!-- Join Team -->
|vo_08_01_title              = Join Team: I
|vo_08_01_file               = {character}{language} Join Team I.ogg
|vo_08_01_tx                 = Talk is cheap. Show me the action.

|vo_08_02_title              = Join Team: II
|vo_08_02_file               = {character}{language} Join Team II.ogg
|vo_08_02_tx                 = May this journey bring us closer to the truth.

|vo_08_03_title              = Join Team: III
|vo_08_03_file               = {character}{language} Join Team III.ogg
|vo_08_03_tx                 = {{Extra Effect|You'tan}} and I will ensure your safety.


<!-- Ascension -->
|vo_09_01_title              = Ascension: I
|vo_09_01_ascension          = 1
|vo_09_01_file               = {character}{language} Ascension I.ogg
|vo_09_01_tx                 = My thoughts are clearing up, and my resonance with {{Extra Effect|You'tan}} is getting stronger… This is all because of your help, isn't it?

|vo_09_02_title              = Ascension: II
|vo_09_02_ascension          = 2
|vo_09_02_file               = {character}{language} Ascension II.ogg
|vo_09_02_tx                 = In this world, there are only those things which are not yet known, not those which cannot be known. I seem to be one step closer to the truth I seek.

|vo_09_03_title              = Ascension: III
|vo_09_03_ascension          = 3
|vo_09_03_file               = {character}{language} Ascension III.ogg
|vo_09_03_tx                 = Your help has opened up a world of potential for {{Extra Effect|You'tan}} and me. It feels a bit foreign to me to be presented with many options, instead of one single truth... but I rather enjoy this feeling.

|vo_09_04_title              = Ascension: IV
|vo_09_04_ascension          = 4
|vo_09_04_file               = {character}{language} Ascension IV.ogg
|vo_09_04_tx                 = You have helped me gain a previously unknown level of power; in return, I will use this power to its fullest extent for you.

|vo_09_05_title              = Ascension: V
|vo_09_05_ascension          = 5
|vo_09_05_file               = {character}{language} Ascension V.ogg
|vo_09_05_tx                 = Once again, you have demonstrated an unimaginable feat. But compared with how it worked, I am now more curious about you as a person. What kind of new possibilities are you going to show me? I have never felt so much anticipation before... Clearly, you are special to me unlike anyone else.
}}
